content: मरुः [म्रियन्तेऽस्मिन् भूतानीति मरुः निर्जलदेशः, मृ-उ <ls>Uṇ. 1. 7</ls>] .²1 A desert, sandy desert, a wilderness, any region destitute of water. .²2 A mountain or rock. .²3 A kind of plant (कुरबक). .²4 Abstinence from drinking; मरुं साधयतो राजन् नाकपृष्ठमनाशके <ls>Mb. 13. 57. 14</ls>, <ls n="Mb. 13.">142. 44</ls>. --{%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab> <ab>N.</ab> of a country or its inhabitants.
